description: Read-oriented storefront endpoints observed on continente.pt.

novel_features.name: Direct storefront session login
novel_features.description: Establish a fresh Continente storefront session from the CLI using the observed PKCE login handoff.

novel_features.name: Browser-session import
novel_features.description: Hydrate the CLI cookie jar from an exported browser session so agents can reuse an operator-authenticated account safely.

novel_features.name: Account-backed cart mutation
novel_features.description: Inspect and mutate the authenticated cart through the live storefront session instead of a guest-only approximation.

novel_features.name: Pickup-slot inspection
novel_features.description: Read live pickup-slot availability for the preferred store from the authenticated checkout flow.
